trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.when: After the other 54 trophies
trophies.guide: Earn the 54 non-platinum trophies, then finish the platinum unlock. Use the PS5 list to spot any missing entry; cross-check A Long Road separately because 100% game completion is a distinct gold trophy.
trophies.missable: Depends on the full list. Keep pre-finale and partner-access saves until all unclear opportunities are checked.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.when: Gone Fishing · opening story
trophies.guide: Follow the opening mission markers through Gone Fishing’s final objective and let its completion sequence finish. Confirm the bronze in the PS5 list; Cal’s later fishing challenge is a separate activity trophy.
trophies.missable: Story mission. If the clear does not unlock it, replay from a save before Gone Fishing and finish its closing sequence.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.when: Chapter 1 · opening story arc
trophies.guide: Keep following the main-story objectives until Chapter 1 ends. Check the trophy list at the transition, then make a fresh save before taking the next chapter’s first mission.
trophies.missable: Story progression. Retain a Chapter 1 save until the unlock is confirmed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.when: Chapter 2 · after Chapter 1
trophies.guide: Continue the main mission chain after Chapter 1 and complete every objective that advances the chapter. At the transition, verify this trophy and check newly available contacts before moving on.
trophies.missable: Story progression. Keep a separate save before the Chapter 2 handoff until it registers.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.when: Chapter 3 · after Chapter 2
trophies.guide: Use the active story objective to distinguish chapter missions from new side markers, then clear the Chapter 3 chain. Before its transition, finish any available partner objectives that require both leads together.
trophies.missable: Story progression. Save before the transition and verify named mission trophies are checked.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.when: Chapter 4 · before the finale
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main objectives until the chapter trophy unlocks. At the next safe point, check the six named mission trophies, restock, and make a manual save before starting the finale.
trophies.missable: Story progression. Chapter 4 and the final-mission gold are separate unlocks; preserve a pre-finale save.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.when: Final story mission · after Chapter 4
trophies.guide: Follow the final main-story marker through its last objective and closing scene. Confirm the gold trophy on PS5 before relying on postgame access for any remaining partner or special-condition trophy.
trophies.missable: Story progression. Keep a pre-finale save because postgame access to particular setups is unverified.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.when: Breakfast Run · story mission
trophies.guide: When the story presents Breakfast Run, select its marker and complete the mission through the final objective. Check the trophy list afterward; use the mission log to confirm the exact job if other markers are open.
trophies.missable: Named story mission. Keep a save before starting until the bronze registers; replay access is unverified.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.when: The Cartel Heist · story mission
trophies.guide: Start The Cartel Heist from its story marker, stock up beforehand, and follow the marked heist objectives through the escape and completion sequence. Verify this mission trophy separately from the five-vault robbery tally.
trophies.missable: Named story mission. Save before accepting the heist until its completion unlock appears.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.when: Child's Play · story mission
trophies.guide: Complete the story job titled Child's Play, continuing through the closing objective after any mid-mission checkpoint. Check the trophy list before starting the next story job.
trophies.missable: Named story mission. Retain a pre-mission save if the clear is recorded without a trophy.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.when: Headliners · story mission
trophies.guide: Select Headliners by its displayed mission title and complete its objective chain to the handoff back to free roam. Confirm the bronze before confusing nearby side activities with this story job.
trophies.missable: Named story mission. Keep the pre-mission save until the trophy appears.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.when: VCIA Takedown · story mission at VCIA
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown story mission through its final objective and verify the bronze. Treat Catch Me If You Can as a separate airport objective unless the game confirms it also counted.
trophies.missable: Named story mission. Preserve a pre-mission save until this unlock registers.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.when: Operation Savage Glory · story mission
trophies.guide: Follow the marker for Operation Savage Glory, complete its objective chain, and wait for the mission clear. Check the trophy list before leaving the result screen; test any Combat Focus setup separately.
trophies.missable: Named story mission. Keep a manual save beforehand if available until the unlock is confirmed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.when: Cleanup · in-game completion checklist
trophies.guide: Open the in-game completion or statistics checklist and clear its listed categories one by one, checking the percentage after each batch. Use that counter as the authority for game completion; the trophy ledger tracks trophy unlocks separately.
trophies.missable: Exact completion requirements and postgame access are unverified. Keep chapter saves and take partner opportunities during the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.when: Free roam · stunt routes across Leonida
trophies.guide: Complete stunts until the in-game count reaches 250. Approach ramps straight, leave enough run-up, and prioritize a clean landing. Confirm each attempt advances the counter before repeating a spot; group proven locations by region.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. Track only stunts that visibly receive credit to avoid a second full sweep.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.when: As activity types unlock across Leonida
trophies.guide: Use the in-game activity list to identify its nine activity types. Complete one session in each distinct type, recording which types receive credit; a second race or venue may repeat a type rather than fill a missing one.
trophies.missable: Activity availability is unverified. Try new types as they appear and check the counter after completing a session.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.when: Any unlocked Shooting Range · 42 challenges
trophies.guide: Earn gold on all 42 range challenges and verify every medal in the challenge list. Learn each drill’s target order in a first attempt, then replay only the remaining silvers; restart early when the gold score is no longer reachable.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. Check all 42 recorded medals before leaving the range.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.when: Free roam · each of 14 Top Fun sites
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun Drone Race at each of its 14 locations. Follow the next-gate markers on a first run to learn the course, then focus on clean turns and a finish recorded as a win. Keep a site-by-site checklist.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. Recheck locked sites after story progress and confirm each location records a win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.when: Free roam · distinct race events as they unlock
trophies.guide: Win 20 different race events, tracking each event name or location after its first victory. Skip rematches until the initial sweep is complete, and confirm drone races count before adding them to this total.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. Count recorded wins in different events, not repeat victories on one course.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.when: Cal’s fishing challenge · when his activity unlocks
trophies.guide: Accept Cal’s marked fishing challenge and note its scoring rule before the timer starts. Play through to the results and finish with a score above Cal’s; ordinary free-roam fishing is not a substitute for a recorded challenge win.
trophies.missable: Cal’s later availability is unverified. Save before the event and take it when his challenge is offered.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.when: An accessible arcade cabinet or game
trophies.guide: Choose an arcade game with a visible final stage or completion screen and play until that end condition appears. Let the result register before exiting; a high score in an endless game may not count as completing it.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. If an endless cabinet gives no credit, try a game with a clear finish.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.when: Andy’s stranger strand · contact marker
trophies.guide: Start Andy’s stranger missions when his marker or contact appears, then complete each follow-up until his final mission ends. Check the map and messages after intervening jobs if the next step does not appear; confirm the finale trophy before counting the strand.
trophies.missable: Replay and postgame access are unverified. Take each offered job and keep a save before Andy’s last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.when: Kenton’s stranger strand · contact marker
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton’s contact prompts and mission markers through his full chain. After each job, check for a follow-up before leaving the area; use this finale trophy to confirm the strand is complete.
trophies.missable: Availability is unverified. Keep a save before Kenton’s final available job until the trophy registers.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.when: Billy’s stranger strand · contact marker
trophies.guide: Accept Billy’s stranger jobs and finish each follow-up until the final mission concludes. If the marker pauses, advance another activity or story job and check messages and the map again; verify the bronze before moving on.
trophies.missable: Availability is unverified. Complete Billy’s jobs when offered and retain a save before the finale.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.when: Across Leonida · as stranger contacts unlock
trophies.guide: Complete eight distinct stranger mission strands from their introductions through their finales. Track each strand separately; use the Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, and Tyrone finale trophies as confirmed checkpoints, then find three more complete strands on the map.
trophies.missable: Strand availability and replay are unverified. Meet contacts during story play and keep a save before branch choices or finales.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.when: Randy’s stranger strand · contact marker
trophies.guide: Follow Randy’s own marker or contact prompt and complete each job through the final mission. Check the mission log after each clear so an absent follow-up is distinguishable from an already completed finale.
trophies.missable: Availability is unverified. Take Randy’s next job when offered and keep a separate save before the finale.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.when: Tyrone’s stranger strand · contact marker
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone’s introduction and every follow-up job, checking contacts between missions for the next marker. Finish his final mission and confirm the trophy before counting toward the eight-strand requirement.
trophies.missable: Availability is unverified. Finish jobs while Tyrone’s line is active and retain a pre-finale save.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.when: Free roam · 18 meditation spots across Leonida
trophies.guide: Visit each of the 18 meditation spots and complete its interaction, not just the discovery. Log completion by region and use the in-game count to find any missed spot; combine nearby stops with area exploration and WAiNK routes.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. Revisit any marked location where you did not confirm the completed interaction.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.when: Bret’s unique-animal hunt · when his strand appears
trophies.guide: Accept Bret’s hunt when it appears, follow the in-game clues to the unique target, and complete the hunt’s closing objective. Check the trophy before leaving the area so you know the special encounter registered.
trophies.missable: Potential one-time opportunity: the target is unique and retry access is unverified. Make a separate save before starting.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.when: Free roam · collectible card sets
trophies.guide: Complete three full card sets, checking collection progress by set rather than counting individual pickups alone. Finish the sets nearest to completion first and plan regional pickup loops around the missing cards shown in the collection screen.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. Confirm each of three sets is marked complete.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.when: Free roam · 100 eligible WAiNK locations
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK action at 100 distinct eligible locations and wait for each on-screen credit before recording the stop. Work through regional loops; if the counter lags, revisit nearby boundary locations rather than repeating confirmed sites.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. Track successful location credits only; repeat eligibility is not confirmed.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.when: Challenge list · as activity goals unlock
trophies.guide: Open the challenge list and complete 50 entries that it records as challenges. Favor objectives that overlap with races, exploration, or other trophies, then check the total after each batch to learn which activities qualify.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. Use the in-game challenge tally rather than assuming every activity event counts.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.when: Shared free roam · while your partner is available
trophies.guide: With both leads together, build a four-star Wanted Level and keep your partner with you while escaping until every star clears. Choose an escape route first and check for the unlock as soon as the search ends.
trophies.missable: Potential partner window. Attempt before the finale while both characters can roam together; later access is unverified.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.when: Shared free roam · three eligible shops nearby
trophies.guide: While your partner is available, pick a route linking three shops that permit robbery. Complete the robberies consecutively and keep the Wanted Level active between stops; if it clears, restart the sequence and verify the trophy afterward.
trophies.missable: Potential partner window. Save during shared free roam and complete this before advancing past the partner opportunity.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.when: Free roam · vehicles across multiple districts
trophies.guide: Reach 100 credited vehicle discoveries by encountering new models around varied districts and vehicle classes. Check what counts on the first few entries, then use the Scooter Bros route to collect unfamiliar eligible vehicles at the same time.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. Confirm a discovery entry before assuming a variant counts as a new vehicle.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.when: Combat encounter · five or more enemies and Combat Focus ready
trophies.guide: Wait for Combat Focus to recharge before entering an encounter with at least five enemies. Activate it once with a clear line to targets and take down all five before that single use expires; use a restartable encounter if the group scatters.
trophies.missable: Later access to suitable encounters is unverified. Save before a promising setup and attempt it while available.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.when: VCIA airport · exact trigger unlisted
trophies.guide: Visit VCIA when airport access is available and look for a departure you can initiate outside a scheduled mission. Test one prompted takeoff or exit at a time and check PS5 progress immediately; the wording does not establish which aircraft or action qualifies.
trophies.missable: Trigger and repeat availability are unverified. Keep a save near VCIA and distinguish this test from VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.when: A Rhino tank encounter · story or free roam
trophies.guide: When a Rhino appears, check its in-game interaction prompts and try the relevant vehicle action while the encounter is active. Verify the trophy before leaving; its description does not specify whether entry, driving, or another action is required.
trophies.missable: Trigger and later tank access are unverified. Preserve a save near a Rhino encounter so you can test again.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.when: An available jewelry-store robbery
trophies.guide: Start the jewelry-store job from a separate save, use its stealth options, and remain undetected through the escape and result. If guards are alerted or the game flags detection, reload and retry before continuing the story.
trophies.missable: Potential clean-run opportunity. Replay access and the exact detection cutoff are unverified; keep a pre-job save.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.when: Bank-vault jobs · five successful escapes
trophies.guide: Complete five bank-vault robberies, including each job’s escape objective. Record the branch or job name and confirm each result; do not count the separate Cartel Heist unless the vault tally advances.
trophies.missable: Vault availability and repeat credit are unverified. Take offered jobs and save before one-off setups.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.when: An armored-truck event · when it appears in free roam
trophies.guide: Intercept an armored-truck activity when its marker appears, complete the robbery objective, then follow the escape prompt until the event result registers. Check trophy progress before leaving the area and retry if the event returns.
trophies.missable: Event recurrence is unverified. Take the first suitable opportunity and keep a nearby save if possible.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.when: Free roam · all 52 Leonida areas
trophies.guide: Explore each of the 52 named areas and wait for its discovery credit. Travel through adjoining regions in a planned loop, then use the game’s area total to locate small boundary pockets you missed; combine the route with meditation and card pickups.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. Keep the in-game discovered-area count visible during the sweep.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.when: Illegal Operation activities · nine gangs across Leonida
trophies.guide: Complete an Illegal Operation for each of the nine gangs. Note the gang named by each job before starting, confirm the robbery result, then search for a different faction rather than repeating a cleared operation.
trophies.missable: Repeat and postgame availability are unverified. Take the first operation offered by each faction and keep a nine-gang checklist.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.when: Ocean Beach · a cocktail venue with a view
trophies.guide: Visit Ocean Beach and find a venue offering a cocktail interaction with a visible view. Use the drink prompt through its animation and check the unlock; if no trophy appears, try another eligible venue in the named area.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. The description identifies the district but not a specific venue.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.when: An accessible vehicle showroom · during a usable showroom sequence
trophies.guide: At a showroom where you can control a display vehicle, drive it through a breakable showroom exit rather than using the normal door. Check the trophy before leaving the area; the exact dealership and setup are not named.
trophies.missable: Potential set-piece opportunity. A usable display car may depend on a sequence; save before entering the showroom.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.when: Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley · named venue
trophies.guide: Go to Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley, start its bowling activity, and complete a full session using the on-screen aim and release controls. Check the trophy after the result rather than assuming a short practice roll counts.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. Use the named alley; other bowling venues may not qualify.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.when: Shared free roam · while both leads are available
trophies.guide: The description hints at a shared activity. While both leads are together, try a short activity the game explicitly offers to the pair and check PS5 progress after its result. Avoid a long grind until an action is confirmed to count.
trophies.missable: Potential partner window. Save while both leads can roam together; the exact activity and later access are unverified.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.when: Choice prompts · throughout the story
trophies.guide: Make choices when the game presents them and check any visible decision counter after each result. The mirrored list reports a 500-count requirement, but which decisions qualify and whether choices can be repeated are not established.
trophies.missable: Eligible choices and repeat credit are unverified. Check any available tally before major story transitions.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.when: A recoverable activity · precise trigger unlisted
trophies.guide: The description implies a successful second attempt. Use a repeatable activity, save before the first try, and check the trophy after retrying and completing it; change only one condition at a time so a qualifying retry can be identified.
trophies.missable: Trigger is unverified. Test on a repeatable activity and preserve a save before any event that may occur once.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.when: An unusual world encounter · trigger unlisted
trophies.guide: Watch for unusual encounters and follow any interaction or event prompt to its conclusion. Note the location and conditions, then check PS5 progress immediately; the title and description do not identify the encounter that qualifies.
trophies.missable: Potential encounter window. Save before approaching a one-off event when possible; repeat availability is unverified.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.when: Free roam · vehicle with melee drive-by controls
trophies.guide: Check the current vehicle control prompts for the melee drive-by input. Try it from close range against a suitable target in free roam and confirm the trophy after the knockdown; adjust distance or vehicle if the hit does not register.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. Practice the prompted input away from a mission before attempting it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.when: Marked Bills laundering · after contacts unlock
trophies.guide: Take Marked Bills to available laundering contacts and record the credited amount after each exchange. Continue until the total reaches $250,000; check a small first transaction to learn whether progress tracks face value or payout.
trophies.missable: Later contact access is unverified. Use contacts when they become available and verify credit while advancing the story.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.when: Cleanup · shop purchases across Leonida
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 on purchases the game credits at shops. Check the counter after an early purchase, then buy useful supplies or upgrades across available stores; keep enough money aside for garage properties.
trophies.missable: No risk indicated. Verify what spending counts before using funds reserved for Little Boxes.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.when: Garage-property listings · as they become purchasable
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property shown in the in-game property list, checking ownership and address after each purchase. Budget the full cost, revisit unavailable listings after story milestones, and verify that the list has no unowned garages.
trophies.missable: Purchase availability and sequence are unverified. Recheck locked listings after story progress and track each owned address.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.when: Scooter Bros app · after it unlocks
trophies.guide: Open Scooter Bros, read the eligibility requirement for each request, and submit ten vehicles the app accepts. Confirm each registration before moving on; combine pickups with new vehicle discoveries when practical.
trophies.missable: Later app access is unverified. Start when unlocked and count only registrations confirmed by the app.

source: PlayStation trophy list · Exophase and PSNProfiles kit snapshots
